name: markmorente
description: Mark Morente static site (Cloudflare Pages). Zero dependencies: node scripts/build.mjs → dist/

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && npx -y wrangler@4 pages dev dist --port 8789
scripts.deploy:preview: node scripts/build.mjs && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name markmorente --branch preview
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && npx -y wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name markmorente --branch main
